function.name: phone_ui
function.description: READ the phone screen as text: one line per actionable node, `flags (x,y) label #id`. This is the cheapest observation (~2 s) and the one to use in a loop. Call it before an action to find the target and after it to prove the screen changed. exit 1 = the label is not on this screen; exit 2 = the view is stale and you must refresh first (in emit mode the output carries the DEVICE_CMD).

max_age.description: emit mode: reuse a dump newer than this many seconds (default 30)

strict.description: emit mode: exit 2 instead of warning when the dump is stale

function.name: phone_tap_text
function.description: Tap a visible label (text or content-desc). Prefer this over coordinates: labels survive resolution and layout changes. Reports where it tapped; exit 1 with `no node matching` means nothing was tapped. Success is not evidence -- call phone_ui afterwards.

function.name: phone_tap_xy
function.description: Tap absolute physical pixels. Use coordinates from phone_ui / phone_observe, never from a downscaled screenshot.

function.name: phone_long_press
function.description: Long press at absolute pixels (default 600 ms).

function.name: phone_swipe
function.description: Swipe. Either a preset (up/down/left/right, scaled from the real screen size) or explicit pixels X1 Y1 X2 Y2 [MS]. Presets survive a change of phone; explicit numbers do not.

function.name: phone_press_key
function.description: Press a key by name: back, home, enter, recents, power, volume_up, delete, tab, escape, or any KEYCODE_* name.

function.name: phone_type
function.description: Type into the focused field. ASCII only: Android's `input text` injects key events, so CJK is silently dropped while the command still exits 0. For Chinese, paste through the clipboard and confirm with phone_ui. Spaces are escaped for you.

function.name: phone_screenshot
function.description: Screenshot to a file and return its path and size. Use only when text is not enough: a canvas, a video, a game, a WebView with no tree. Downscale to keep the pixels small.

function.name: phone_observe
function.description: One call that returns screenshot path AND the UI tree. The widest observation; costs the most.

function.name: phone_foreground
function.description: Which app/activity is in front. Cheaper than a full tree and the fastest way to confirm a tap opened something. A UI signal, not a proof of progress.

function.name: phone_size
function.description: Screen geometry (physical pixels). Needed only when you compute coordinates yourself.
